question: Estimate the annual revenue of a successful YouTube creator in India with 5M subscribers.
idealClarificationQuestions: Mid-tier creator (5M subs, ~50M views/month) in lifestyle/tech/finance category? Yes.
All revenue sources: AdSense + brand deals + own products + memberships? Yes.

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Own products / courses / merchandise: ~₹2-3 Cr (varies hugely).

expectedLogicalStructure.label: Calculate
expectedLogicalStructure.description: Round: ~₹15-17 Cr for a 5M-subscriber Indian YouTuber in lifestyle/tech.

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: YouTube AdSense RPM for India (per 1,000 views)
benchmarkAssumptions.value: ~₹120-180 (varies by niche; finance highest, vlogs lower).

benchmarkAssumptions.parameter: Brand deals / sponsored integrations (~3-5/month at ₹3-15 lakh each)

calculationFlow: YouTube AdSense RPM for India (per 1,000 views): ~₹120-180 (varies by niche; finance highest, vlogs lower).
Brand deals / sponsored integrations (~3-5/month at ₹3-15 lakh each): ~₹3-5 Cr/year.
Own products / courses / merchandise: ~₹2-3 Cr (varies hugely).
Round: ~₹15-17 Cr for a 5M-subscriber Indian YouTuber in lifestyle/tech.

finalAnswerRange.ideal: ~₹15-17 Cr for a 5M-subscriber Indian YouTuber in lifestyle/tech.
